title_sq: Ne Kinostudio, Shiten 2 Garsoniere dhe 6 Apartamente 1+1, Ideale Per Investim!!!

title_en: In Kinostudio, 2 studios and 6 1+1 apartments are for sale, ideal for investment!!!
description_en: Kinostudio sells 2 studios and 6 1+1 apartments, ideal for investment. The property is located on the 1st and 2nd residential floors of a 10-story building, well-managed with an elevator. Each floor has 1 studio and 3 1+1 apartments with an area of ​​220 m2 each, the total area of ​​the 8 apartments is 440 m2. The property has been in use as Airbnb for 1.5 years now, they are fully invested. We also have 2 parking spaces on the -1st floor with extra value. The area in which the apartments are located is very favorable as it is at the intersection of the main roads and offers all the necessary facilities.
